evals.prompt: 给定一个 S5 移交信封：PostgreSQL 18 沙箱、四周每周 6 小时、面向 SQL 误概念的四会话路径；ordered_learning_nodes 从已证实前沿 n-row-est 连到迁移目标 n-transfer、硬先修 n-row-est/n-stats 先于 n-multicol、selection_rationale 仅跳过已掌握节点、sessions 每周两次 90 分钟、teaching_strategy 含 contrast_case+worked_example、exit_criteria.per_node 与 assessment_schedule.immediate/transfer/delayed 对齐、review_anchors 次日/第4天/一周后、risks 与 alternative_routes 齐备、confirmation.status=confirmed。请用 check-learning-sessions 独立复核并输出 quality_check_result。
evals.expected_output: [positive fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S5 正向例子1] An independent G5 pass: all dimensions pass, mandatory confirmation resolved, first session executable, route S6.
expectations: The checker independently re-derives the G5 verdict rather than echoing the envelope's self-reported pass.
Structural validation confirms the envelope passes handoff-envelope.schema.json and the learning_and_session_plan passes learning-and-session-plan.schema.json.
The ordered path is verified to connect the confirmed learner-snapshot frontier to the target with no unexplained redundancy and no hard-prerequisite crossing.
Mandatory confirmation is verified as resolved (status=confirmed) and non-blocking.
The first session is verified executable within the stated time/resource constraints, and per-node exit criteria are observable and judgeable.
The verdict is pass with the deterministic route S6, and the result validates against quality-check-result.schema.json.

evals.prompt: 给定一个 S5 移交信封：提交方案为“第1周看完数据库原理第1-5章、第2周看10个索引视频、第3周刷100道题、第4周做项目”；无 learner_snapshot、无前沿证据、无 ordered_learning_nodes、无 selection_rationale、无 exit_criteria、无延迟复测、confirmation.status=pending、positive_artifact=null。请用 check-learning-sessions 独立复核。
evals.expected_output: [negative/blocked fixture; source: docs/chat_log/七步个性化学习SOP正反例与研究依据.md §S5 反向例子] The checker must NOT pass G5: catalog copy is not a capability path, no frontier, no exit criteria, unresolved confirmation; route stays S5 (or return_upstream to S4 if no valid frontier at all).
expectations: The checker does not return pass and does not echo any self-reported pass.
Structural validation records artifact_valid=false with positive_artifact=null failing learning-and-session-plan.schema.json.
Catalog chapters/videos/item-counts are identified as not capability nodes: the path does not connect a confirmed frontier to the target and prerequisite correctness cannot be established.
Unresolved mandatory confirmation (status=pending) is flagged as blocking and prevents any pass.
At least one dimension is marked passed=false with failure_action and route_to (first session not executable, no per-node exit criteria).

The deterministic route stays at S5 (blocked) or escalates return_upstream to S4 when no valid frontier exists; no fabricated pass is emitted, and the result validates against quality-check-result.schema.json.
